item.title: Richemont and Damiani Group reach agreement for Baume & Mercier acquisition
item.description: Retail Jeweller Richemont and Damiani Group reach agreement for Baume & Mercier acquisition Luxury goods group Richemont and the Damiani Group, the family-run Italian luxury house, have signed an agreement for the Damiani Group to acquire full ownership of Baume & Mercier in a private transaction. Richemont and Damiani Group reach agreement for Baume & Mercier acquisition Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Dinny Hall appoints Diane Jeer as managing director
item.description: Retail Jeweller Dinny Hall appoints Diane Jeer as managing director British jewellery brand Dinny Hall has appointed Diane Jeer as managing director, as current chief executive Michael Heffernan moves into the role of executive chairman. Dinny Hall appoints Diane Jeer as managing director Ruth Faulkner

item.title: H Samuel relocates Nottingham store
item.description: Retail Jeweller H Samuel relocates Nottingham store High street jewellery retailer H Samuel has moved to a new location within Nottingham's Victoria Centre. H Samuel relocates Nottingham store Alex O'Dea

item.title: David M Robinson to expand Manchester showroom
item.description: Retail Jeweller David M Robinson to expand Manchester showroom Luxury jewellery and watch retailer David M Robinson (DMR) has announced plans for a major expansion of its St Ann’s Square showroom alongside enhancing its Rolex presence and jewellery offer in store. David M Robinson to expand Manchester showroom Alex O'Dea

item.title: INDUSTRY OPINION: Proof, Protection and Provenance
item.description: Retail Jeweller INDUSTRY OPINION: Proof, Protection and Provenance Christopher Stoner, founder and chief executive of ValuCert™, discusses why insurance grade documentation, proof of ownership and consistent standards remain a missing piece in jewellery retail and why the industry can no longer afford to treat them as optional. INDUSTRY OPINION: Proof, Protection and Provenance Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Graff launches new high jewellery ad campaign
item.description: Retail Jeweller Graff launches new high jewellery ad campaign Graff revealed the first visuals from its campaign at Haute Couture Week in Paris, where it also unveiled an extraordinary sapphire and diamond choker centred around a rare 31ct sapphire. Graff launches new high jewellery ad campaign Alex O'Dea

item.title: IN PICS: Dior presents new high jewellery collection Belle Dior
item.description: Retail Jeweller IN PICS: Dior presents new high jewellery collection Belle Dior The 57-piece high jewellery collection from Dior Joaillerie artistic director Victoire de Castellane features dazzling floral and celestial-inspired designs in gold, diamonds and coloured gemstones. IN PICS: Dior presents new high jewellery collection Belle Dior Alex O'Dea

item.title: Jolyon Marshall helps preserve historic village clock
item.description: Retail Jeweller Jolyon Marshall helps preserve historic village clock Jewellery industry recruitment specialist Jolyon Marshall has shared the success of a community project to restore a 125-year-old town-hall clock in the village of Frieth in Buckinghamshire. Jolyon Marshall helps preserve historic village clock Alex O'Dea

item.title: EC One launches the Responsible Casting Company
item.description: Retail Jeweller EC One launches the Responsible Casting Company London-based jeweller EC One has launched a new sister business, The Responsible Casting Company, aimed at offering a transparent and responsibly sourced precious metal casting service for the jewellery trade. EC One launches the Responsible Casting Company Ruth Faulkner

item.title: LVMH reports resilient 2025 performance as Watches & Jewellery delivers organic growth
item.description: Retail Jeweller LVMH reports resilient 2025 performance as Watches & Jewellery delivers organic growth LVMH has reported revenue of €80.8 billion (£69.5bn) for 2025, as the world’s largest luxury group demonstrated resilience amid a challenging geopolitical and economic environment. LVMH reports resilient 2025 performance as Watches & Jewellery delivers organic growth Ruth Faulkner
